5namespace App\Http\Middleware;
6
7use App\Models\Employee;
8use Closure;
9use Illuminate\Http\Request;
10use Sentry\State\Scope;
11use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
12
13use function Sentry\configureScope;
14
15/**
16 * Enrich Sentry scope with tenant + user context on every API request.
17 *
18 * This middleware adds company_id, user role, and plan information to
19 * Sentry events so that errors can be triaged per-tenant in the dashboard.
20 */
21class SentryContextMiddleware
22{
23    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
24    {
25        if (! function_exists('Sentry\\configureScope')) {
26            /** @var Response */
27            return $next($request);
28        }
29
30        $user = $request->user();
31
32        if ($user instanceof Employee) {
33            configureScope(function (Scope $scope) use ($user, $request): void {
34                $scope->setUser([
35                    'id' => (string) $user->id,
36                    'email' => $user->email ?? '',
37                    'segment' => $user->role,
38                ]);
39
40                $scope->setTag('tenant.company_id', (string) $user->company_id);
41                $scope->setTag('user.role', $user->role);
42
43                if ($user->manager_role) {
44                    $scope->setTag('user.manager_role', $user->manager_role);
45                }
46
47                $scope->setContext('tenant', [
48                    'company_id' => $user->company_id,
49                    'role' => $user->role,
50                    'manager_role' => $user->manager_role,
51                    'request_id' => $request->header('X-Request-Id', ''),
52                ]);
53            });
54        }
55
56        /** @var Response */
57        return $next($request);
58    }
59}
